site: Balm Park and Recreation Center, 14747 Balm Wimauma Rd
about: Balm Park is a 10-acre Hillsborough County park in southeastern Hillsborough County, and it includes a community center that the county offers for rental.
The county lists the park at 14747 Balm Wimauma Rd, Wimauma, FL 33598, and the park grounds are open daily from sunrise to sunset.
This breakfast is a county Parks and Recreation program, so families sign up through the same online registration system the county uses for classes and activities at Balm Recreation Center.
The county's event page promises pancakes, juice, holiday crafts, festive music and a photo with Santa, followed by a reading of The Night Before Christmas.
Santa arrives at 11:30 AM, about halfway through the two hour morning, so guests who come early have time for crafts before he walks in.
The county lists no minimum age for guests, which makes it a workable outing for toddlers, school age children and older siblings together.
Attendance is capped at 100 participants, and the county adds that weather related cancellations are possible.
The county asks families to bring their own cameras and to pack bug spray.
Questions go to Heather Gay of Hillsborough County Parks and Recreation at (813) 285-8816, and the park's main line for facility questions is (813) 671-7671.
